title: fix(studio): Interfaces designs the current package's app, not another's
body:
## Problem

Opening `/_console/studio/<packageId>/interfaces` for a package with **no app** rendered a **different** package's navigation tree.

The Interfaces pillar resolved its app with an unscoped `list('app')` and a client-side `.find()` by package:

```js
const apps = await client.list('app');                 // ALL apps, every package
const app = apps.find(a =>
  a._packageId === packageId || a.packageId === packageId || a.name === packageId
) ?? apps[0];                                           // ← leaks another package's app
```

List rows carry no `packageId`, so the `.find()` never matched and it fell through to `?? apps[0]` — the first app in the whole system. For `com.example.test` (which has no app) this showed `showcase_app`'s nav; a package that genuinely had no app was stuck on an endless `加载中…`. The header's own "打开应用/创建应用" bridge already resolved correctly via `list('app', { packageId })`, so the two disagreed.

## Fix

- **Scope to the package** — `list('app', { packageId })`, no cross-package fallback (matches the header's resolution).
- **Draft apps** — a freshly-created (still-draft) app is picked up via `listDrafts({ packageId, type: 'app' })`, so it's designable before its first publish (`list()` only sees published metadata). Re-resolves on `publishNonce`/`draftNonce`.
- **Real empty state** — when the package has no app, the nav rail and canvas show `这个软件包还没有应用` with a `创建应用` action wired to the header's existing create flow (single source of truth), instead of an endless spinner.
- **Editable empty nav** — edit mode now renders `AppNavCanvas` even on an empty tree, so the first nav item can be added.

## Verification

Ran the console (`apps/console`, src-aliased `@object-ui/app-shell`) against a showcase backend and drove it with chrome-devtools:

- `/studio/com.example.test/interfaces` → empty state `这个软件包还没有应用` + `创建应用` (no `showcase_app` leak). ✅
- `/studio/com.example.showcase/interfaces` → `showcase_app`'s full nav tree + header `打开应用`, Start Here page live in the canvas. ✅
- Canvas `创建应用` opens the header's create popover (`onCreateApp → setAppCreating(true)`). ✅
- Network trace confirms the scoped `GET /meta/app?package=…` and that `listDrafts` is skipped when a published app exists. No new errors (the `?state=draft` 404s are the pre-existing, `.catch`-handled "no draft" responses).

`@object-ui/app-shell` builds clean via turbo (deps built).
